configuration.title: Homepage
configuration.description: The address a new tab opens. Empty, it opens the start page, the bookmarks as tiles.

configuration.title: Search engine
configuration.description: Where words typed in the address bar are searched.

new-tab.description: Opens a new tab, at the address given or the homepage.

reopen-tab.description: Opens the tab closed last again, where it was.

show-notification.description: Brings forward the tab a site's notification came from, and tells the site it was pressed.

switch-to-tab.description: Brings an open tab to the front.

open-bookmark.description: Opens a bookmark in a new tab.
